title: Gus and the Mud
learning_objectives: Decode CVC words with short u
Read a story that mixes all five short vowels
parent_prompts: New sound: short u as in mud, tub, run. Stretch it: m-u-d.
After reading: what did Gus do that made a mess? What fixed it?

pages.text: Gus is a pup. Gus can run.
pages.illustration_brief: A small brown puppy running in a yard, ears flapping.
pages.audio_script: Gus is a pup. Gus can run.
pages.image_alt: A small brown puppy running in a yard.

pages.text: Gus runs to the mud. He digs in the mud. Dig, dig, dig!
pages.illustration_brief: The puppy digging at a muddy patch, dirt flying.
pages.audio_script: Gus runs to the mud. He digs in the mud. Dig, dig, dig!
pages.image_alt: The puppy digging at a muddy patch, dirt flying.

pages.text: Gus runs in. Mud on the rug! Mud on the mat! Mud on Mum!
pages.illustration_brief: Muddy paw prints across a rug toward a woman holding up her hands.
pages.audio_script: Gus runs in. Mud on the rug! Mud on the mat! Mud on Mum!
pages.image_alt: Muddy paw prints across a rug toward Mum with her hands up.

pages.illustration_brief: A big tub with bubbles; Mum pointing; Gus looking guilty.
pages.audio_script: Gus! Into the tub! said Mum.
pages.image_alt: A big tub with bubbles; Mum pointing; Gus looking guilty.

pages.text: Gus sits in the tub. Rub, rub, rub. The mud is gone.
pages.illustration_brief: Gus in the tub covered in bubbles; Mum scrubbing.
pages.audio_script: Gus sits in the tub. Rub, rub, rub. The mud is gone.
pages.image_alt: Gus in the tub covered in bubbles; Mum scrubbing.

pages.text: Gus hops out. He is wet. He runs to the mud! "Gus, no!"
pages.illustration_brief: Gus leaping from the tub toward the door, trailing water; Mum reaching after him.
pages.audio_script: Gus hops out. He is wet. He runs to the mud! Gus, no!
pages.image_alt: Gus leaping from the tub toward the door, trailing water; Mum reaching after him.

quiz.explanation: t-u-b. The middle sound is short u and the last sound is b.

quiz.prompt: Why is there mud on the rug?

options.text: Gus dug in the mud and ran in

quiz.explanation: Gus dug in the mud (page 2) and then ran inside (page 3).

quiz.prompt: At the end, what do you think will happen next?
quiz.explanation: On page 6 Gus runs back to the mud, the same mud he dug in on page 2.

quiz.prompt: Tell a grown-up where the mud went and how Mum got Gus clean.
quiz.rubric: not yet: says mud only; with support: names the tub with prompting; independent: rug, mat and Mum got muddy; tub and rubbing cleaned him; he ran back to the mud
quiz.explanation: Retelling the mess, the fix and the funny ending shows full comprehension.

items.text: Mud gets on the rug and on Mum.
Gus gets rubbed clean in the tub.
Gus runs back to the mud.

activities.prompt: Match the words with the same middle sound.

off_screen_prompt: Find three things at home with the u sound like tub: cup, bus, rug... Say them slowly.

review.decodability_note: Short-u CVC: Gus, pup, run(s), mud, rug, Mum, tub, rub, dug; earlier: can, dig(s), sit(s), mat, hop(s), wet, in, on. 'out', 'gone' on review; kept for story sense.
